title: Thick-tufted layer 5B neurons are the cell type most tied to consciousness

statements.text: If one cell type had to be picked, it would be the thick-tufted layer 5B neurons: the major output neurons of the cortex, which project heavily to the nonspecific thalamus and receive long-range cortico-cortical input on their apical dendrites.

sources.quote: If we would have to pick one specific type of neuron, then it would be the thick-tufted L5B neurons
